description: PHASE 5 - the bounds of CROSS-CONTEXT authoring, read by BOTH api/services/definition_conversation.py + alert_user_series.py (authoritative) and authoring/applyPatch.js (the browser gate). One file so the two languages cannot disagree about which symbol spellings and timeframes an authored tree may name. sym: a store-servable ticker (1-5 letters, optional class-share '.X'), never a spelling that also names an index/commodity elsewhere (engine/otherSymbols.js BARE_AMBIGUOUS reads this list), at most maxOtherSymbols distinct tickers per definition. tf (last CLOSED period) and tf_live (the FORMING period, repaints) name W or M only. calculationTimeframes: the whole-instance calculation timeframes an authored request may route to (instanceControls CALC_TIMEFRAMES); a lower timeframe than the chart's is never offered.
